Subject: Evaluation-to-signature: MAP alignment & contract sequencing (MSA / DPA / Order Form)

Hi Asha —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation, I attached a draft MAP (MAP_Stellar_v3.xlsx) that ties the evaluation milestones to the contracting milestones so we can get to a clean signature window. High level:

- Evaluation gates (pilot success criteria, data retention, performance targets) map directly to the Order Form acceptance rows so your product team can validate before we trigger billing.
- DPA items that typically block procurement (data residency, subprocessor list, incident SLAs) are flagged as legal gating items and given owner/ETA.
- MSA redlines that impact commercial terms (indemnity cap, liability carve-outs) are called out separately so procurement can track escalation.

As next steps, can you confirm:
1) Target legal review cutoff (we suggested 11/25 to allow procurement to complete by 11/30)
2) Whether Stellar needs a vendor security package (we can share SOC2 evidence now)
3) Any internal sign-off steps we should add to the MAP (finance, information security, compliance)

I'll loop in Karthik to start DPA redlines and Marissa to keep the commercial Order Form in sync. If those timelines work for you we'll schedule a 30-min alignment call tomorrow afternoon to walk the MAP and finalize owners.

Attachments: MAP_Stellar_v3.xlsx

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Commercial Lead, Redwood Inference

Grace —

Appreciate the MAP — that layout is helpful. A few quick notes from procurement/legal side:

- Procurement timeline: our target is to complete internal procurement approvals by COB 2026-11-30. To hit that we need legal redlines back by 2026-11-25.
- DPA asks: can you confirm whether Redwood will accept our standard data residency clause (we are asking for EU-only processing for the pilot dataset) or whether you need an approved subprocessor list first?
- Finance: order form must show quarterly invoicing cadence and PO reference; can Marissa produce a version of the Order Form with pricing placeholder?

I'll attach our vendor intake checklist (we'll email the formal procurement questionnaire if needed). Also FYI legal@ will want explicit incident SLA language and a breach notification timeline (72 hours).

If you can get redlines and the MAP final by end of day 11/25, procurement will move it forward for signature the week of 11/29.

Thanks,
Asha Patel
Head of Vendor Procurement, Stellar Health

On Sun, Nov 21, 2026 at 1:22 PM, Asha Patel <asha.patel@stellarhealth.com> wrote:
> Grace —
> 
> Appreciate the MAP — that layout is helpful. A few quick notes from procurement/legal side:
> 
> - Procurement timeline: our target is to complete internal procurement approvals by COB 2026-11-30. To hit that we need legal redlines back by 2026-11-25.
> - DPA asks: can you confirm whether Redwood will accept our standard data residency clause (we are asking for EU-only processing for the pilot dataset) or whether you need an approved subprocessor list first?
> - Finance: order form must show quarterly invoicing cadence and PO reference; can Marissa produce a version of the Order Form with pricing placeholder?

Hi Asha, Grace —

Thanks for the notes. Quick legal read and proposed plan:

1) DPA/data residency: Redwood can scope EU-only processing for the pilot under a scoped SOW; we'll require the subprocessor list disclosure in advance of any production ramp. Proposed fix: add a pilot-scoped residency addendum in the Order Form and a passing clause in the DPA that enumerates the pilot dataset and residency constraints.

2) Incident SLA/notification: we are prepared to accept 72-hour notification and will add a clarified incident classification table to the DPA redline.

3) Liability & indemnity: we will propose a limited carve-out for customer-provided data processing errors; see the attached DPA_redlines_Stellar.pdf for suggested language. Note that material changes to indemnity may need front-line exe approval for higher-value deals.

4) Order Form: Marissa — can you create an OrderForm_SOW_v1.docx with placeholder pricing and quarterly invoicing so procurement can circulate?

5) MAP adjustments: I've added a legal gating column (owner: Karthik) to the MAP where each DPA clause is mapped to a legal action + ETA. Also included a short decision tree for residency requests.

If Grace confirms we should align for an internal redline pass by 11/24 EOD (so we can return to Asha/legal by 11/25). Attaching: DPA_redlines_Stellar.pdf.

Regards, 
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

Asha —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming the plan and owners below so procurement has a single source of truth:

- Legal (Karthik): produce final DPA redline with residency addendum and incident table by 11/24 EOD. (Attachment: DPA_redlines_Stellar.pdf)
- Commercial (Marissa): publish OrderForm_SOW_v1.docx with quarterly invoicing and placeholder pricing by 11/24 EOD.
- Sales (Grace): run a MAP walkthrough with Stellar POC and procurement on 11/24 3:00pm PT (calendar invite incoming).

If the above happens on schedule, we expect: legal approve -> procurement complete -> signature window 11/29–11/30. Any deviation from the 11/24 internal cutoff will likely push signature into next week.

Next steps: I will send the calendar invite and the MAP export with the new legal gating column attached. Please reply with any blocking asks (e.g., additional evidence, PO forms) and we'll surface them immediately.

Thanks,
Grace
